channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Can Yemen retake territory seized by Houthis?
item.description: The group has taken control of much of the Red Sea coast.

item.title: Turkiye, Pakistan agree to military deployment to Saudi Arabia
item.description: Turkiye, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan have agreed to trigger collective deterrence measures in response to Houthi attacks.

item.title: Trump blames Democrats and Ukraine for soaring US fuel prices, not Iran war
item.description: Trump shifts blame for fuel price hikes to blue states like California and Ukraine strikes on Russian oil refineries.

item.title: Turkiye, Pakistan agree Saudi Arabia military deployment under Mecca pact
item.description: The three countries agree to trigger collective deterrence measures in response to 'heinous attacks' by Yemen's Houthis.

item.title: Zelensky condemns 'horrific' Russian strike on boat carrying corn in Black Sea
item.description: The vessel's captain was killed and 11 crew members were rescued after the attack on the Turkish-owned ship, Ukraine's leader says.

item.title: Georgia officials hunt for suspect in shooting that killed two and injured 35
item.description: A homecoming celebration turned into a scene of deadly violence, as dozens of shots were fired into a crowd.

item.title: Yemeni military says it has retaken Mokha and 'secured' Red Sea waterway
item.description: Saudi-backed forces say they seized the port city of Mocha, near the Bab al-Mandab Strait, at the start of an offensive against the Houthis.
